people.name: Haman
people.line: A Persian official who plotted to destroy the Jews.

people.name: Mordecai
people.line: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.

translations.web: Mordecai came back to the king’s gate, but Haman hurried to his house, mourning and having his head covered.
translations.bsb: Then Mordecai returned to the king’s gate. But Haman rushed home, with his head covered in grief.
translations.kjv: And Mordecai came again to the king's gate. But Haman hasted to his house mourning, and having his head covered.
translations.asv: And Mordecai came again to the king's gate. But Haman hasted to his house, mourning and having his head covered.
